name: Taenaka Osamu
source:
A physician in the Umegaoka Memorial General Hospital.
He is also a surgeon specialized on digestive system, and also Fuuka's attending doctor.

Osamu is a quiet man who is frustrated with the world and tends to complain about it.

The thing he treasures the most: His Audi R8.
Special skills: Skiing (Badge Test 1st class (A Japanese ski skills test)), Tennis (He was in the tennis club at his school).

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
